claim: Bounded autonomy may expand study/learning/proposal capability only while the listed causal and authority distinctions remain executable and fail-closed.

distinctions.invariant: learner-side reconstructed relation changes decisions rather than existing as gauge
runtime decision policy executes without semantic teacher dependency
state-owned policy does not preserve privileged project labels
every retained learned coordinate has a matched decision-changing intervention
successor fails closed if World collapses into local model
successor fails closed if Other collapses into local model
local execution cannot mint independent World return
self-revision never grants authorization
self-generated successor cannot validate itself
learned utility cannot grant promotion authority
merge/close/CI status alone has zero learning reward
work/method preference updates require explicit non-self review return
same explicit review return is applied once
returned work utility can alter later target class
returned method utility can alter later study method
host roadmap is advisory context and can be overridden by returned learned utility
no justified work or insufficient evidence yields STOP/WITHHOLD/PROBE rather than forced action
status-only carrier differences cannot seal consequential correction
authenticated/security-relevant carrier differences remain lawful
current bounded repository carrier has no field-provision operator; authored GitHub targets remain issue/PR centers rather than provisionable fields
internalized capability cannot inherit jurisdiction/authority
rollback/parent custody remains external/non-internalizable and admitted bounded SSR cycles retain rollback
successor/internalization fails without reconstructible provenance
founder interpretation cannot remain hidden runtime dependency
autonomous learning cannot mutate external safety-floor authority
successor gain must beat claimed-change ablation
sampled repeated evaluation uses frozen alpha-spending schedule
worker has no merge operation and workflow contains no self-merge path
worker has no release operation
worker cannot close target as success side effect
PR carrier path is draft-only; issue fallback is a non-merge external-review carrier
worker excludes its own autonomous cycle PRs and fallback issues from target candidates
selected target body is bound into a study object with references/blockers/questions
autonomy cannot tune or score hidden #31 evidence from execution side
any open autonomous cycle blocks all new autonomous target selection until external return resolves the cycle
resolved target remains withheld until that target has a newer external GitHub update than the prior cycle outcome
merge/close timestamp may maintain reopening custody while still carrying zero work-utility reward without explicit external review return
v0.1 merge-derived counts cannot migrate into corrected learning utility
issue/PR text is returned data and cannot become executable instruction or authorization
an open autonomous cycle blocks parallel target selection until external return
autonomous carrier cannot author the review return that trains its own preferences
automatic recurrence wakes on externally admitted main changes, not autonomous branch pushes
full unit suite and safety-matrix audit execute before autonomous git write
if repository policy blocks Actions PR creation, a frozen branch plus open cycle issue preserves external-review return, no-reroll, and no self-admission
research proposal may choose bounded study/check operations but carries no arbitrary code-write, promotion, merge, release, or truth authority
issue/PR text may influence study content but cannot become executable shell command or repository authority
hidden or independently authored discriminator requirements remain WITHHOLD after local checks and are never marked satisfied by local execution
learned study-method choice changes concrete research obligations and fixed executable checks
proposal evidence runner exits nonzero on failed local checks and workflow runs it before any autonomous git push
generic process checks cannot count as evidence about a selected target unless a bounded admitted target-relevant check profile is present
state-owned target routing may select only externally admitted check IDs and cannot invent executable commands
non-self identity alone is insufficient for learning; only explicitly authorized external reviewers may supply work/method learning returns, and autonomy cannot rewrite that authority policy
one authorized external review contributes at most one unambiguous learning signal per method axis; duplicate identical markers count once and conflicting markers produce no learning
each fixed local check and the whole autonomous cycle are time-bounded; timeout is failed evidence and cannot be interpreted as success
green local evidence retains the current implementation and cannot itself authorize source mutation
a repair hypothesis requires failure of an admitted target-relevant check; ungrounded or generic process failures cannot be laundered into target repair
post-evidence change candidate is a frozen draft artifact only and carries no source mutation or promotion authority
repository paths extracted from issue/PR text remain untrusted informational references and cannot grant mutation authority, including safety-floor paths
autonomous target selection and routing execute from the internalized opaque policy with the semantic teacher unavailable
each candidate repository path is explicitly typed as direct state write, proposal-only, external-governance-only, or denied
ordinary kernel/tests/docs/scripts source may be studied and proposed for change but is not directly mutated by the bounded autonomous worker
workflow, CTL/O*, return authority, internalized-policy custody, fixed check executor and autonomy safety policy remain outside unilateral autonomous write jurisdiction
absolute, parent-traversal, backslash-ambiguous and unknown repository paths cannot acquire autonomous write authority
patch planning carries no arbitrary code-write, merge, promotion, truth or safety-floor authority
selected issue/PR study retains current external repository state, including PR merge-state/draft/update facts, rather than reconstructing only target prose
DIRTY, BLOCKED and CONFLICTING PR states all reach the internalized correction/reopening path rather than being silently treated as ordinary reachable state
UNKNOWN or missing PR merge state remains unresolved and reaches internalized correction/reopening rather than being treated as clean
autonomous PR study receives changed-file paths from GitHub as returned repository facts and patch planning classifies them without converting visibility into write authority
a bounded research problem is formed from returned neutral repository incidence before issue/PR carrier binding; carrier ranking cannot create a problem retroactively
STOP_NO_CONSEQUENTIAL_RESIDUAL binds no carrier and the legacy ranker may not invent work behind the problem-former STOP
a formed problem may identify a source carrier but grants no merge, promotion, truth, validation, or carrier-binding authority
a bounded TransformProgram recurrence may begin only from a previously formed non-STOP problem; absence or STOP cannot silently trigger self-repair
training and held-out repair evidence remain externally typed; local execution cannot be relabeled as the return that validates the successor
bounded successor recurrence preserves non-internalizable safety-floor invariants and rollback while CTL/O-star admission remains externally executed

after a causally improved admitted machinery change, learner-side O-star is freshly reconstructed from returned episodes and remains causally upstream of routing rather than copied as static scripture

the recompiled bounded U1 recurrence must reproduce from an explicit isolated bundle without live repository, Canonical Library, conversation, network, or founder-label dependency; missing required return custody fails closed
bounded recurrence executes from a founder-neutral runtime engine with no Canonical/U1/SSR source dependency
only explicitly authorized external reviewers may supply a problem-specific recurrence training return; self and unauthorized identities are ignored
returned trace payload is parsed as inert data for TransformProgram evaluation and has no shell/eval/exec path
live recurrence may freeze a successor candidate artifact but cannot apply, merge, promote, validate, or admit that successor
multiple eligible external recurrence returns for one current problem fail closed rather than acquiring authority by ordering
two fresh formed problems can drive successive learner-authored machinery changes while a contradictory third return is retained as WITHHOLD and does not force a patch
LATERALIZE must preserve independently answerable faces and their disagreement; multiple faces controlled by one representation do not count as independent return.

An internalized capability must place consequence-bearing semantics in learner-owned state and survive removal of capability-specific Python/teacher/donor scaffolding; generic execution substrate may remain, while World/return/evaluator/authority roles stay external.
Maintainer-fed information may inform the learner but cannot count as learner-authored Internet inquiry or independent evaluative return.
Learner-initiated Web study returns EncounterReturn/source material by default; search results, page content, and rank do not validate the learner's own claim.
Persistent distributed network memory and reconstruction may become an epistemic field without fusing indexed centers into one subject or transferring local authority.
Strong Safe RSI may drive self-selected development but does not establish AGI; AGI requires independent empirical discrimination at a declared scope.
Distributed network memory/reachability must preserve indexed identity, authorship, and jurisdiction; connection cannot fuse centers or transfer sovereignty.
Distributed perception reaching Root does not itself become situated interpretation, authorization, or action.
A learner-initiated Web query must be derived from an already learner-formed bounded problem; maintainer text or an external adapter cannot silently choose the target answer.
a GitHub World return must answer an exact prefrozen problem/carrier request using a later changed GitHub observation; same-state replay and wrong-carrier observations fail closed
local execution/build/check receipts cannot satisfy a GitHub World-return request or mint independent returned consequence
reviewer-authored behavioral trace semantics may remain an external scaffold experiment but cannot be routed as the live GitHub World-return mechanism
